detail.longDescription: I just released Discophile, an open-source desktop player for your self-hosted music. It works with # Navidrome , # Jellyfin , # Subsonic and # Audiobookshelf , and builds mixes from your own listening history. My favorite part: tell it you have 45 minutes and it suggests three whole albums that fit. Synced lyrics, AutoEq, ReplayGain, gapless. No account, no telemetry. Built in # RustLang with # egui . Runs on macOS, Windows, Linux and in the browser. https:// github.com/debba/discophile # SelfHosted # FOSS
